runaway.description: Typical runaway: slow incubation for days, then accelerating heating and fire.

fast_runaway.description: Fast runaway: short incubation (2-3 days), rapid transition to fire.

slow_incubation.description: Slow incubation: stays near the critical point for many days (hard to detect).

dropout_during_heating.description: Gas telemetry lost for ~2 days spanning the incubation -> active-heating transition.

ventilation_shock.description: No heating, but airflow is halved for 3 days (gas concentrations double).

blasting_storm.description: No heating, but heavy shot-firing with large CO spikes every shift.

self_quenching.description: Heating that is sealed/cooled after reaching ~100 C (should alarm, then recover).
